liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd74-10-18.sbd.bertha-ashley.22796.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 219 min; rated 4.79/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are clearer in this recording compared to other available versions of the show; Hissy audio with low Jerry mix, but features the longest uninterrupted jam into Dark Star; Dark Star is well-crafted with smooth transitions, evolving into a funky jazz-rock feel [13][14][22][24]
- **gd1974-10-18.176647.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]
- **gd74-10-18.sbd.romanski.5436.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 121 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Seastones into Dark Star is tight and delicate, though the rest of the set drags [15]
- **gd74-10-18.sbd.miller.21785.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 219 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Second set's Phil and Ned to Dark Star sequence is ephoric and special [17]
- Billy and Phil drive the band, making the first set particularly strong [18]
- Listening while driving on a black night evokes exploring multi-colored caverns with pixie dust [23]
- Ned Lagin played electric piano and synthesizer for the Seastones performance [7]
- Listener believes this Dark Star to Dew sequence is from the Grateful Dead movie [19]
- Considered the best Morning Dew of 1974, featuring zero mistakes and huge power [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-10-18.sbd.bertha-ashley.22796.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard master reel remaster, transferred via MDAT to SHN, rated Sound B to A+ [1]
- **gd1974-10-18.176647.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [7]
- **gd74-10-18.sbd.romanski.5436.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [12]
- **gd74-10-18.sbd.miller.21785.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]
